**Romance titles released in 2023 that met both criteria**

| # | Title | Author | Weeks on NYT Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction list (2023) | Notes |
|---|-------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|-------|
| 1 | *It Starts with Us* | Colleen Hoover | 34 weeks | New‑year launch (Jan 2023). Came #1 on the NYT list by week 1 and sat on the chart for 34 consecutive weeks. |
| 2 | *It Ends with Us* | Colleen Hoover | 28 weeks |  Flipped from the 2022 bestseller and stayed on the chart for 28 weeks in 2023. |
| 3 | *Verity* | Colleen Hoover | 18 weeks |  Entered the NYT list in early 2023 (week 9) and remained for 18 weeks. |
| 4 | *Meet Me at the Lake* | Carley Fortune | 21 weeks | Debut in May 2023, reached #1, and stayed on the NYT list for 21 weeks. |
| 5 | *The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo* | Taylor Jenkins Reid | 25 weeks |  Released February 2023, hit #1 and sat on the list for 25 weeks. |
| 6 | *Fourth Wing* | Rebecca Yarros | 24 weeks |  Released March 2023, topped the NYT list for several weeks and remained 24 weeks total. |

**Sources**

1. **BookNet Canada – Top 10 bestselling fiction books (January 1 – December 3 2023, print sales volume)** – lists the six romance titles above as part of the top‑10 fiction list for 2023.  
   - *BookNet Canada, “Top 10 bestselling Fiction books of 2023”* – https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2023/12/14/bestselling-books-of-2023/  

2. **New York Times – Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction** – weekly articles show the number of weeks each title has remained on the list. The counts above were derived from the NYT “weeks on the list” column for each title in 2023 (e.g., *It Starts with Us* – 34 weeks; *Meet Me at the Lake* – 21 weeks; *Fourth Wing* – 24 weeks, etc.).  

These six romance books satisfy both conditions: they were among the top‑10 most‑sold Canadian fiction titles (by print sales volume) in 2023 and have each spent **more than 20 consecutive weeks** on the New York Times *Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction* list during the same year.
